data.steelman: The rebound is real in the reported data, yet the largest venue gains may reflect temporary incentives rather than durable demand. If those spikes fade, aggregate seven-day growth can turn negative by the resolution date.
data.rebuttal: This is reported usage, not a roadmap claim: aggregate seven-day DEX volume is already up 16.0%. The growth is also present at major venues users actually route through: Uniswap V4 is up 9.8%, Uniswap V3 is up 25.4%, and Aerodrome Slipstream is up 11.4%. The other view correctly flags extreme jumps at smaller venues, but it needs the broader, liquid venues to reverse enough to overcome the current aggregate trend. Until that shows up in DeFiLlama’s reported series, positive growth is the higher-probability outcome.
